For Khuzaima Raja ❤️

Happy 24th Birthday • 28 July 2002

"Some people quietly become home."



Dear Khuzaima,

Happy Birthday.

This isn't an expensive gift. It's simply a small corner of the internet made for someone who quietly became one of the most meaningful parts of my life.

If someone had told me that replying to a simple Facebook story would lead me here, writing this letter for you, I wouldn't have believed them. I thought we'd exchange a few messages and then continue living separate lives. Instead, life surprised me.

You moved to Canada. I stayed here. Different countries, different time zones, yet our conversations never disappeared. Morning messages, late-night talks, random jokes, little updates about our days... they quietly became part of my everyday life.

I don't remember one dramatic moment when everything changed. It happened through ordinary conversations that slowly became extraordinary. Somewhere between those little moments, you became someone I deeply care about.

Thank you for your kindness, your patience, and for accepting me exactly as I am. You probably don't even realise how much comfort you've brought into my life.

We've never shared a coffee, never walked through the rain together, and never celebrated your birthday in the same room. Yet you've already become one of the people I cherish the most.

Today you turn 24. My wish isn't for a perfect future. My wish is simply that life is kind to you, that your heart stays at peace, and that one day we turn these conversations into real memories.

Thank you for replying to one simple Facebook story. Thank you for staying. Thank you for being you.

Happy Birthday, ZI.

With love,
Hasnain ❤️

Our Someday List 🌸

  • ☐ Walk through a city with no destination.
  • ☐ Go shopping and laugh over little things.
  • ☐ Watch the sunset together.

  • ☐ Grow old while collecting simple, beautiful memories.

One Last Thing ❤️

Maybe the best chapter of our story hasn't happened yet.

Until then, thank you for becoming one of the most meaningful people in my life.

Happy 24th Birthday,
Khuzaima Raja.
